pipeline_contract.name: straddie-tender-timeline-v1
pipeline_contract.description: Pipeline-readable tender and procurement records for Straddie-connected opportunities. Records must be source-backed, dated, and tagged for downstream grants, ledger, events, resilience, digital twin, Mineral Moonshots and Civilisation of Sand pipelines.
pipeline_contract.update_rule: Add or update records only from official source pages or official tender portals. Use tbc for uncertain dates. Do not infer an open tender from a policy page, media release, strategy page or old awarded contract.
